en: Some children are playing on the grass.
zh: 有些小孩在草地上玩。

en: He wants no kind of flowers.
zh: 他不想要任何种类的花。

en: He does not want any kind of flowers.
zh: 他不想要任何种类的花。

en: Ask her where he parked his car.
zh: 问她他把他的车给停哪儿了。

en: He acted like he owned the place.
zh: 他把自己当成了这里的主人。

en: I'll go with you when pigs fly.
zh: 山无棱，天地合，我就跟你走。

en: Why are pigs so fat?
zh: 猪为什么都那么肥？

en: He lives in that house over there.
zh: 他住在那边的那间房子。

en: The old man lived there by himself.
zh: 这个老人独自住在那里。

en: He heard his name called from behind.
zh: 他听到有人从后面叫他的名字。

en: The sun is hiding behind the clouds.
zh: 太阳公公躲在云朵后面。

en: When can you come to my home?
zh: 你什么时候能来我家？

en: She feels at ease in their home.
zh: 她在他们家里感觉很放松。

en: They like the beautiful stars and moon.
zh: 他们喜欢美丽的星星和月亮。

en: Unfortunately, these beautiful words are not mine.
zh: 不幸，这些美丽的此不是我写的。

en: Why do all the guys like her?
zh: 为什么所有的小伙子都喜欢她？

en: If you like it, just buy it.
zh: 如果你喜欢，买就是了。

en: He hid his friend from the police.
zh: 他把他的朋友藏了起来不让警察知道。

en: He left his fortune to his son.
zh: 他把财产留给了他的儿子。

en: "Are you tired?" "No, not at all."
zh: “你累吗？”“不，一点儿也不。”

en: War must be avoided at all costs.
zh: 战争必须不惜一切代价地去避免。

en: How do we get out of here?
zh: 我们该怎么从这里出去。

en: Time is short, we must act NOW.
zh: 时间不多，我们必须马上行动。

en: What kind of shoes does this factory make?
zh: 这家工厂制造什么样的鞋子呀？

en: Try to avoid making any more trouble.
zh: 尽量避免制造任何更多的麻烦。

en: My best friend now lives in Australia.
zh: 我最好的朋友现在住在澳洲。

en: My friend can speak Chinese and Japanese.
zh: 我朋友会说汉语和日语。

en: If you want to know, just ask.
zh: 如果您想知道，直接问就是了。

en: If you need anything, let me know.
zh: 如果你需要任何东西，让我知道。

en: The sea can be heard from here.
zh: 我们从这里可以听到海的声音。

en: We can hear the ocean from here.
zh: 我们从这里可以听到海的声音。

en: One is new, and the other is old.
zh: 一个是新的，另一个是旧的。

en: That old tradition has disappeared.
zh: 那个古老的传统已经不复存在了。

en: He is the last man to steal.
zh: 他是最后一个偷东西的人。

en: He may have missed the last train.
zh: 他可能错过了最后一班火车。

en: Hope to see you again next year.
zh: 希望明年再次见到你。

en: He works hard all the year round.
zh: 他一年到头努力工作。

en: "Does he like music?" "Yes, he does."
zh: "他喜欢音乐吗？""是的，他喜欢。"

en: "Are these your cars?" "Yes, they are."
zh: “这些车是你的吗？”“是的，是我的。”

en: Let me introduce you to Mr. Murata.
zh: 让我介绍你认识村田先生。

en: Take care of Mr. Tanaka for me!
zh: 为我照顾田中先生！

en: We lost our way in the woods.
zh: 我们在树林中迷路了。

en: We will visit our teacher next week.
zh: 下周我们要去看望我们的老师。

en: Not all of us can speak English.
zh: 我们并不是全部都会讲英语。

en: All of these meetings are in English.
zh: 所有这些会议都是以英语进行的。

en: My dream is to become a teacher.
zh: 我的梦想是成为一名教师。

en: He has decided to become a teacher.
zh: 他已经决定要成为一名教师。

en: Do you remember which year it happened?
zh: 你记得这是在哪一年发生的吗？

en: We didn't know which bus to take.
zh: 我们不知道要搭哪一班公交车。

en: Excuse me, who is this woman?
zh: 请问，这位女士是什么人？

en: People who love doubt nothing, or doubt everything.
zh: 喜欢的人什么都不怀疑，或什么都疑神疑鬼。

en: You can trust him with any job.
zh: 任何工作你都可以放心的交给他。

en: He is still green at the job.
zh: 他在工作中经验尚浅。

en: The clever student finished the test quickly.
zh: 聪明的学生很快完成了测验。

en: Any student can answer that question.
zh: 任何学生都可以回答这个问题。

en: His mother looks young for her age.
zh: 他妈妈看起来比实际年龄年轻。

en: People your age often have this problem.
zh: 您这个年龄的人经常有这个问题。

en: She cried when she heard the news.
zh: 当她听到这个消息的时候，她哭了。

en: Do you know when she will come?
zh: 你知道她什么时候会来吗？

en: This is one of my favourite books.
zh: 是我最喜欢的书之一。

en: Nighttime is my favourite time of day.
zh: 夜晚是我一天中最喜欢的时候。

en: My pet is sick.
zh: 我的宠物生病了。

en: Do you have any pets?
zh: 你养宠物吗？

en: His office is very close to mine.
zh: 他的办公室跟我的非常近。

en: All of us like you very much.
zh: 我们都非常喜欢你。

en: He looked cute in his photos.
zh: 他在他的照片里看上去很可爱。

en: This baby penguin is too cute!
zh: 这只企鹅宝宝太可爱了！

en: The child missed his mother very much.
zh: 这孩子非常想念他的母亲。

en: Thank you very much for your gift.
zh: 非常谢谢你的礼物。

en: The bus stop is near our school.
zh: 巴士站离我们的学校近。

en: He is doing very well at school.
zh: 他在学校的表现很好。

en: Will you go to China next year?
zh: 你明年去中国吗？

en: There is no tipping culture in China.
zh: 中国人没有给小费的习惯。

en: The panda is unique to China.
zh: 熊猫是中国独有的。

en: The panda is China's national treasure.
zh: 熊猫是中国的国宝。

en: Is the milk cold, or still hot?
zh: 这牛奶是冷的还是热的？

en: It is very hot here in summer.
zh: 这里夏天非常炎热。

en: Lisa speaks not only English but also French.
zh: 丽萨不但会说英文，而且会说法文。

en: My hobbies are not only wide-ranging but also useful.
zh: 我的爱好不但广泛而且有用。

en: I have always wanted to see traditional Chinese music performed live.
zh: 我一直想看中国传统音乐的现场表演。

en: We watched the live show of the Spring Festival Gala on TV.
zh: 我们在电视上看了春节联欢晚会的直播。

en: Mine is blue with red.
zh: 我的是蓝色的，带有红色。

en: He bored us with his long stories.
zh: 他长长的故事让我们觉得厌烦了。

en: Let me introduce my parents to you.
zh: 让我给你介绍一下我的父母。

en: Let me introduce you to my parents.
zh: 让我给你介绍一下我的父母。

en: Have you ever read any Chinese poems?
zh: 你读过任何一首中国诗词吗？

en: Which day do you learn Chinese?
zh: 你星期几学汉语？

en: What type of food do you like?
zh: 你喜欢什么样的食物？

en: Green plants can make their own food.
zh: 绿色植物可以食物自给自足。

en: This store has lots of great gifts.
zh: 这家商店有大量的极好的礼物

en: Your behavior is creating a lot of problems.
zh: 你的行为引起了许多的麻烦。

en: This is about as large as that.
zh: 这个大约跟那个一样大。

en: The board is about two meters long.
zh: 这块木板大约两公尺长。

en: He hit the wall with his fist.
zh: 他打了墙壁一拳。

en: The picture is hanging on the wall.
zh: 那幅图挂在墙上。

en: Our team lost all of its games.
zh: 我们的队伍输了所有的比赛。

en: Not all red apples taste the same.
zh: 不是所有的红苹果吃起来味道都一样。

en: They rent the car by the hour.
zh: 他们按小时租车。

en: The plane will take off in one hour.
zh: 飞机将在一小时后起飞。

en: Long long ago, there lived a pretty girl.
zh: 很久很久以前住着一个漂亮的小女孩。

en: It happened a long time ago.
zh: 这事发生在很多年以前。

en: My family is very proud of me.
zh: 我的家庭为我很骄傲。

en: All of his family members are tall.
zh: 他的所有家庭成员都很高。

en: What is the name of that bird?
zh: 那只鸟叫什么名字？

en: Is the bird alive or dead?
zh: 那只鸟是死还是活的？

en: Who do you want to speak to?
zh: 你想跟谁说话？

en: Do you want to speak to Tom?
zh: 你想跟汤姆说话吗？

en: He likes sports as well as music.
zh: 他喜欢运动，也喜欢音乐。

en: He likes sports and also likes music.
zh: 他喜欢运动，也喜欢音乐。

en: He often laughs at his own jokes.
zh: 他常常因他自己的笑话而笑。

en: Do you go to the movies often?
zh: 你常常去电影院吗？

en: We used to play in the park.
zh: 我们过去常在公园玩。

en: Can you teach me to play chess?
zh: 您能教我下国际象棋吗？

en: My plans failed one after the other.
zh: 我的计划一个接一个的失败了。

en: We have to look after our parents.
zh: 我们要照顾我们的父母。

en: Do you want this job or not?
zh: 你想不想要这工作？

en: What kind of book do you want?
zh: 你想要甚么类型的书？

en: He can be proud of his father.
zh: 他可以为自己的父亲而骄傲。

en: Hurry up, or you will be late.
zh: 快一点，否则就要迟到了。

en: Pardon me, what place is this?
zh: 请问这儿是什么地方？

en: Keep the money in a safe place.
zh: 把钱保存在安全的地方。

en: Her only pleasure is listening to music.
zh: 她唯一的乐趣就是听音乐。

en: Please lower the volume of the music!
zh: 请把音乐声调小！

en: She loves the doll like her own sister.
zh: 她像喜爱自己的亲妹妹一样喜欢这个娃娃。

en: As a child, he loved to swim.
zh: 他小时候喜爱游泳。

en: Give me some paper to write on.
zh: 给我一些纸来写字。

en: How do you write your last name?
zh: 你的姓氏怎么写？

en: He often plays tennis with me.
zh: 他经常和我打网球。

en: She was deeply attracted by a tennis match.
zh: 她被一场网球比赛深深吸引住了。

en: Her favourite food is Mapo tofu.
zh: 她最喜欢的食物是麻婆豆腐。

en: Tofu is made from beans, and it is popular all over China.
zh: 豆腐是用豆子做的，在全中国都很受欢迎。

en: How is Peter's school similar to yours?
zh: 彼得的学校和你的学校有什么相似之处？

en: My pen is broken. Can I use yours for a minute?
zh: 我的钢笔坏了。能借你的用一会儿吗？

en: This is Unit 1 of our English book.
zh: 这是我们英语书的第一单元。

en: In which unit of a textbook can the text be found?
zh: 这篇短文可以在课本的哪个单元找到？

en: Would you like tea or something?
zh: 你需要茶或者别的什么吗？

en: You may go swimming or fishing.
zh: 你可以去游泳或者钓鱼。

en: My mother is busy in the kitchen.
zh: 我的母亲在厨房里正忙着。

en: My mother used to be into tennis.
zh: 母亲以前很喜欢打网球。

en: Even a child knows right from wrong.
zh: 就连小孩子也会分辨是非黑白。

en: That child who spoke is my brother.
zh: 那个说话的小孩是我弟弟。

en: Your sister cannot swim well, can she?
zh: 你的姐姐游泳得不好，是不是？

en: He always mistakes me for my sister.
zh: 他老是把我和我姐姐搞错。

en: My brother swims every day in summer.
zh: 我弟弟夏天的时候每天都会去游泳。

en: He is my brother, not my father.
zh: 他是我哥哥，不是我爸爸。

en: He went to stay with his cousin.
zh: 他去和他的表弟待在一起了。

en: I get on very well with your cousin.
zh: 我与你的表亲相处甚好。

en: Father named me after his aunt.
zh: 父亲以他姑姑的名字为我命名。

en: My aunt died of lung cancer.
zh: 我的阿姨因肺癌去世了。

en: She will get along with my grandmother.
zh: 她应该能跟我奶奶相处得来。

en: My grandmother gets up early every morning.
zh: 我奶奶每个早上起床很早。

en: What did you come here so early for?
zh: 你这么早来到干甚么？

en: When did you come to China?
zh: 您什么时候来到中国的？

en: Our team is seeded in the ping-pong competition.
zh: 我们队是这次乒乓球比赛得标的热门队。

en: Do you know whose this is?
zh: 你知道这是谁的吗？

en: Do you know whose handwriting this is?
zh: 你知道这是谁的字吗？

en: We cannot sleep well on summer nights.
zh: 在夏天的晚上，我们睡得不是很好。

en: You may as well come with me.
zh: 你不如跟我一起来。

en: He does not come here every day.
zh: 他不是每一天都来这里。

en: We work every day but Sunday.
zh: 我们除了周日每一天都工作。

en: Today is the first day of 2019.
zh: 今天是2019年的第一天。

en: Today is our last day of vacation.
zh: 今天是我们最后一天放假。

en: She is coming back next week.
zh: 她下星期就回来了。

en: They will arrive a week from today.
zh: 他们将于下个星期的今天抵达。

en: We go fishing from time to time.
zh: 我们时不时地去钓鱼。

en: Come along with me and go fishing.
zh: 跟我一起去钓鱼。

en: My father retired at 65 years old.
zh: 我的父亲65岁的时候退休了。

en: He is as tall as his father.
zh: 他和他爸爸一样高。

en: Who is the man playing the piano?
zh: 那个正在弹钢琴的男人是谁？

en: She can play the piano very well.
zh: 她可以把钢琴弹得很好。

en: Why do you like playing basketball?
zh: 您为什么喜欢打篮球？

en: I watched the basketball game on TV.
zh: 我看了电视播的篮球赛。

en: The boy has learned to read.
zh: 男孩学会了阅读。

en: But he is bad at reading English.
zh: 但是他不擅于阅读英文。

en: Rocks are beautifully arranged in the Japanese-style garden.
zh: 石头被美丽得放置在日式庭园里。

en: He likes to work in the garden.
zh: 他喜欢在花园里工作。

en: Do you eat it in the classroom?
zh: 您在教室里吃它吗？

en: Take off your caps in the classroom!
zh: 在教室里请摘下帽子！

en: They make good use of their rooms.
zh: 他们好好地利用他们的房间。

en: Someone left their umbrella in the hall.
zh: 有人把他们的雨伞落在走道里。

en: Is the water in the glass clean?
zh: 杯子里的水干净吗？

en: You must always keep your hands clean.
zh: 你应该一直让手保持干净。

en: This little girl let the birds escape.
zh: 这个小女孩让小鸟脱逃了。

en: What are you looking at, little one?
zh: 小家伙，你在看什么？

en: He hit the ball with his racket.
zh: 他用他的球拍击球。

en: We are going to the ball.
zh: 我们去参加舞会了。

en: A group of young people are playing handball on the playground.
zh: 一群年轻人在操场上打手球。

en: The three clubs joined up to improve the town's playground facilities.
zh: 三家俱乐部联合起来共同改善镇上运动场的设施。

en: She likes to wear dark colours.
zh: 她喜欢穿深颜色的衣服。

en: What size shoes do you wear?
zh: 你穿几号的鞋子？

en: Who do you want to talk to?
zh: 你想跟谁说话？

en: Do not talk with your mouth full.
zh: 别边吃东西边说话！

en: The tall man left in a hurry.
zh: 高的男人匆匆地走了。

en: This is a very tall tree.
zh: 这是棵很高的树。

en: Rabbits have long ears and short tails.
zh: 兔子长着长长的耳朵和短短的尾巴。

en: In a word, life is short.
zh: 总而言之，生命是很短的。

en: How do you want your hair cut?
zh: 你想怎么剪你的头发？

en: He is beginning to lose his hair.
zh: 他开始掉头发了。

en: There is a long wait between trains.
zh: 在火车的间隔中有漫长的等待。

en: After a long journey we finally arrived.
zh: 经过漫长的旅程，我们终于到了。

en: Our teacher demanded that we keep quiet.
zh: 老师要我们保持安静。

en: Be quiet. The kids are asleep.
zh: 请安静！孩子们在睡觉。

en: Who is the girl at the door?
zh: 在门口的女孩是谁？

en: Who is the girl in this picture?
zh: 这张照片里的女孩是谁？

en: She is poor, but she is happy.
zh: 她很穷，但是她很快乐。

en: Mmm, but you must wait for me.
zh: 嗯，但是你必须等我。

en: You can buy it at any bookstore.
zh: 你可以在任何一家书店买到它。

en: You may choose any book you like.
zh: 你可以选择任何你喜欢的书。

en: There are five people in this photo.
zh: 这张照片有五个人。

en: He secretly showed me her photo.
zh: 他给我偷偷地展示了她的照片。

en: Who is the woman dressed in pink?
zh: 那个穿粉红色衣服的女人是谁？

en: The rose is pink.
zh: 玫瑰是粉红色的。

en: His mother is sitting on his left.
zh: 他的母亲坐在他的左边。

en: His mother is sitting to his left.
zh: 他的母亲坐在他的左边。

en: Tell me the right answer to it.
zh: 告诉我正确的答案。

en: Is this the right bus for Boston?
zh: 这辆是去波士顿正确的巴士吗？

en: He is tall, fat and always busy.
zh: 他又高又胖，还总是很忙。

en: Why do you always avoid that topic?
zh: 你为什么总是逃避这个话题？

en: You will have heard this story before.
zh: 您以前应该听过这个故事。

en: Thanks for sharing your story with me.
zh: 谢谢你跟我分享你的故事。

en: At night, she gazed at the moon.
zh: 她在夜晚望着月亮。

en: The night reveals truths hidden by day.
zh: 夜晚会揭示白天隐藏的真相。

en: The wall is projected in the middle.
zh: 墙壁中部凸出。

en: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
zh: 路中间有一辆卡车。

en: You should think before you speak.
zh: 你在说话前应该先思考。

en: Don't expect others to think for you!
zh: 别指望别人替你思考。

en: You are going to play football tomorrow.
zh: 你明天会踢足球。

en: The football game is now on the air.
zh: 电视台现在正在播放足球赛。

en: She is poor, but she looks happy.
zh: 她很穷，但却很快乐。

en: Rich as she is, she is not happy.
zh: 她很有钱，生活却过得不快乐。

en: She looked me in the eye.
zh: 她看着我的眼睛。

en: Why do we have eyes in front?
zh: 眼睛为甚么长在前面？

en: He is more clever than wise.
zh: 与其说他有智慧，不如说他聪明。

en: Though he is clever, he isn't wise.
zh: 即使他有些小聪明，但是他并不智慧。

en: We need to take the next right.
zh: 我们得在下一个路口右拐。

en: What to do next is the question.
zh: 问题是下一步要做什么。

en: No need to tell him. He knows.
zh: 你不必告诉他。他已经知道了。

en: Watch him and do the same thing.
zh: 看着他并且跟他做同样的事情。

en: He asked the man to help him.
zh: 他叫那个男人帮助他。

en: We should always try to help others.
zh: 我们一直都应该尽力帮助他人。

en: We spend most of the time in our classroom.
zh: 我们大部分时间待在教室里。

en: Doctors say that many students are spending too much time in front of screens.
zh: 医生说，很多学生花在屏幕前的时间太多了。

en: We are very different, but we have a lot of fun together.

zh: 嗯，知识就像一条链子，把新知识和旧知识联系起来才记得最牢。

en: It used a chain to make the back wheel turn, just like today's bikes do.
zh: 它用一条链条带动后轮转动，就像今天的自行车一样。

en: It was amazing that he did scientific research in physics and chemistry even though he didn't receive a formal education.
zh: 令人惊叹的是，尽管没有受过正规教育，他仍在物理和化学领域进行了科学研究。

en: They use scientific instruments to study weather conditions around the world and make forecasts.
zh: 他们用科学仪器研究世界各地的天气状况并作出预报。

en: Many people could not afford to buy enough clothes.
zh: 很多人买不起足够的衣服。

en: I can't afford such an expensive bike.
zh: 我买不起这么贵的自行车。

en: This place isn't convenient to public transportation.
zh: 这地方交通不方便。

en: The Panama Canal has played a very important role in transportation.
zh: 巴拿马运河在运输上起到了非常重要的作用。

en: Who will you vote for for president?
zh: 你选谁当总统？

en: For whom will you vote for president?
zh: 你选谁当总统？

en: I cannot iron my clothes. I have no iron.
zh: 我没法烫我的衣服，我没有熨斗。

en: Strike while the iron is hot.
zh: 打铁趁热。

en: Acid acts on things which contain metal.
zh: 酸性会腐蚀含有金属的物质。

en: Copper and silver are both metals.
zh: 铜和银都是金属。

en: Our creativity and emotional intelligence are important for relationships.
zh: 我们的创造力和情绪智力对人际关系很重要。

en: These little actions will soon build up your creativity and confidence.
zh: 这些小行动很快会增强你的创造力和自信。

en: He is my senior by two years.
zh: 他比我大两岁。

en: George is five years senior to me.
zh: 乔治比我大五岁。

en: In the text, what words are used to describe people's feelings?
zh: 文中用了哪些词来描写人们的感受？

en: Do we already have that text?
zh: 我们已经有那篇课文了吗？

en: He is the manager of a big hotel.
zh: 他是一家大酒店的经理。

en: "We treat every customer as a family member," said Manager Wang.
zh: “我们把每位顾客都当作家人。”王经理说。

en: Oh, don't forget to watch the opening ceremony.
zh: 哦，别忘了看开幕式。

en: The week ended with a ceremony.
zh: 这一周以一场典礼结束。

en: Cleaning the classroom is our task today.
zh: 打扫教室是我们今天的任务。

en: We are determined to fulfil the task.
zh: 我们决心完成这项任务。
